english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for attracting someone's attention or interest.
This is the all-purpose verb for drawing something physically toward you or drawing someone's attention, interest, or desire.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when something holds or attracts someone’s attention or interest.
Use this as the all-purpose verb when something attracts someone's interest.
Use this when something attracts or appeals to someone rather than persuading them to act.
Use this when something is attractive or interesting to someone, as in “That idea appeals to me.”
Use 吸引 when something takes hold of or draws someone’s attention, interest, or imagination.
Use 吸引 when something grabs or holds a person's attention or interest.
Use this when something attracts attention or draws people toward it.
